title: Matrix factorization of quotient singularities of type A and D
summary: In this article, we extend the classical relationship between ADE singularities and their maximal Cohen-Macaulay modules to quotient singularities of types A and D. We identify projected hypersurfaces which allow us to construct explicit matrix factorizations, and in return, families of maximal Cohen-Macaulay modules. These hypersurfaces also yield the dual resolution graphs of the corresponding quotient singularities via Oka's method. Finally, we show that all special Cohen-Macaulay modules over the original quotient singularity can be recovered from those over the projected hypersurfaces.
